description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to coordination leases and lease candidates in the v1beta1 version, including structures for Lease, LeaseSpec, LeaseList, LeaseCandidate, LeaseCandidateSpec, and LeaseCandidateList, with associated metadata and annotations for code generation and lifecycle management.

classes.name: Lease
classes.description: Represents a lease object used for leader election and coordination.

classes.name: LeaseSpec
classes.description: Specifies details of a lease, including holder identity, duration, renewal times, and strategy.

classes.name: LeaseCandidate
classes.description: Represents a candidate for a lease, used in leader election.

classes.name: LeaseCandidateSpec
classes.description: Specifies details of a lease candidate, including lease name, ping and renew times, versions, and strategy.
